facts.fact: BurundiPay, the national instant payment system run by the BRB, had about 224,000 users and about BIF 4.29 billion in cumulative transactions on 4 August 2026, with customers paying from bank accounts or e-wallets.

On BurundiPay 17 institutions (5 commercial banks, 10 microfinance institutions, 2 payment institutions) are live, and customers can transfer money and pay instantly from bank accounts or e-wallets, per the BRB.
BurundiPay is described as the national instant payment system run by the BRB, live since 5 March 2026 and launched publicly on 23 April 2026.

systems.owner: Bank of the Republic of Burundi
